LESSON: EQUATIONS OF STRAIGHT LINES

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: MATHEMATICS
Strand: Algebra
Topic 2.2: Equations of Straight Lines
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 15

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Equations of Straight Lines, part of Algebra in Grade 9 MATHEMATICS.

Key inquiry question: when y is zero and the value of y when x is zero. How do we use gradient or steepness in our daily activities?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Equations of Straight Lines together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Digital Literacy: learner uses digital divices or other resources to explore the steepness or gradient of places.

● Learning to Learn: learner places the ladder at different points on the ground as they discuss and compare steepness.

Values:
Integrity: learner observes gradient/steepness in staircases in buildings, bridges or ramps.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Safety: learner climbs up and down places such as the stairs or hills and relates to gradients.

Link to other Learning Areas:

● The learner relates the concept of gradient to making work easier in Integrated Science by use of an inclined plane.

● The learner relates the concepts of parallel and perpendicular lines to technical drawing in Pre-Technical studies.
